### Added

- (agent-platform) [Workspace editor with sources, filters and live preview](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2969) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Customize's Workspaces tab has `New workspace`, and each row `Edit` and `Sync now`. The editor picks an organization's repositories by name or by language and topic, excludes ones you don't want, and previews what the workspace selects, with its size, before you save.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.13.0...v3.14.0
